verses.en: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
verses.pt: A verdadeira sabedoria edificou sua casa; ela lavrou suas sete colunas.
verses.en_web: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
verses.en_bbe: Wisdom has made her house, putting up her seven pillars.

verses.en: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.
verses.pt: Ela sacrificou seu sacrifício, misturou seu vinho, e preparou sua mesa.
verses.en_web: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
verses.en_bbe: She has put her fat beasts to death; her wine is mixed, her table is ready.

verses.en: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,
verses.pt: Mandou suas servas, e está convidando desde os pontos mais altos da cidade, dizendo:
verses.en_web: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:
verses.en_bbe: She has sent out her women-servants; her voice goes out to the highest places of the town, saying,

verses.en: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
verses.pt: Qualquer um que for ingênuo, venha aqui.Aos que têm falta de entendimento, ela diz:
verses.en_web: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
verses.en_bbe: Whoever is simple, let him come in here; and to him who has no sense, she says:

verses.en: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.
verses.pt: Vinde, comei do meu pão; e bebei do vinho que misturei.
verses.en_web: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!
verses.en_bbe: Come, take of my bread, and of my wine which is mixed.

verses.en: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.
verses.pt: Abandonai a tolice; e vivei; e andai pelo caminho da prudência.
verses.en_web: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
verses.en_bbe: Give up the simple ones and have life, and go in the way of knowledge.

verses.en: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.
verses.pt: Aquele que repreende ao zombador, toma desonra para si mesmo; e o que tenta corrigir ao perverso acaba sendo manchado.
verses.en_web: He who corrects a mocker invites insult. He who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
verses.en_bbe: He who gives teaching to a man of pride gets shame for himself; he who says sharp words to a sinner gets a bad name.

verses.en: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.
verses.pt: Não repreendas ao zombador, para que ele não te odeie; repreende ao sábio, e ele te amará.
verses.en_web: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise man, and he will love you.
verses.en_bbe: Do not say sharp words to a man of pride, or he will have hate for you; make them clear to a wise man, and you will be dear to him.

verses.en: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
verses.pt: Ensina ao sábio, e ele será mais sábio ainda; instrui ao justo, e ele aumentará seu conhecimento.
verses.en_web: Instruct a wise man, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.
verses.en_bbe: Give teaching to a wise man, and he will become wiser; give training to an upright man, and his learning will be increased.

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
verses.pt: O temor ao SENHOR é o princípio da sabedoria; e o conhecimento dos santos é a prudência.
verses.en_web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
verses.en_bbe: The fear of the Lord is the start of wisdom, and the knowledge of the Holy One gives a wise mind

verses.en: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
verses.pt: Porque por mim teus dias serão multiplicados; e anos de vida a ti serão aumentados.
verses.en_web: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
verses.en_bbe: For by me your days will be increased, and the years of your life will be long.

verses.en: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.
verses.pt: Se fores sábio, serás sábio para ti; e se fores zombador, somente tu aguentarás.
verses.en_web: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
verses.en_bbe: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself; if your heart is full of pride, you only will have the pain of it.

verses.en: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.
verses.pt: A mulher louca é causadora de tumultos; ela é tola, e não sabe coisa alguma.
verses.en_web: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.
verses.en_bbe: The foolish woman is full of noise; she has no sense at all.

verses.en: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
verses.pt: E se senta à porta de sua casa, sobre uma cadeira, nos lugares altos da cidade;
verses.en_web: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
verses.en_bbe: Seated at the door of her house, in the high places of the town,

verses.en: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
verses.pt: Para chamar aos que passam pelo caminho, e passam por suas veredas, dizendo:
verses.en_web: To call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,
verses.en_bbe: Crying out to those who go by, going straight on their way, she says:

verses.en: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
verses.pt: Qualquer um que for ingênuo, venha aqui! E aos que tem falta de entendimento, ela diz:
verses.en_web: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” as for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
verses.en_bbe: Whoever is simple, let him come in here: and to him who is without sense, she says:

verses.en: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.
verses.pt: As águas roubadas são doces; e o pão escondido é agradável.
verses.en_web: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
verses.en_bbe: Drink taken without right is sweet, and food in secret is pleasing.

verses.en: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.
verses.pt: Porém não sabem que ali estão os mortos; seus convidados estão nas profundezas do Xeol.
verses.en_web: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
verses.en_bbe: But he does not see that the dead are there, that her guests are in the deep places of the underworld.
